set.body:
Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5177SNQYXPK746CQXYT3WV on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: doing. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T13:46:09.589514Z.

Run the architecture falsification matrix only after G4 passes.

Required lanes:
A. True CC + rank-one + midpoint + separated controllers.
B. Lane A with the old accumulated-inverse hard gate.
C. True CC + rank-one + one-direction update.
D. Standardized-center surrogate + rank-one + midpoint + separated controllers.
E. Frozen current standardized multi-feature + 3x3 HalfFlow-LM control.

Acceptance gate:
- Do not add a true-CC 3x3 lane unless a mathematically explicit residual factorization is first reviewed and independently tested.
- Comparable lanes use identical native inputs, supplied affine, CC radius where applicable, work grids, smoothing strength, optimization masks, and accepted-step budgets; differences are listed explicitly.
- Run at least five labeled development pairs before selecting an architecture, with labels and moving evaluation masks held out. Expand the cohort before claiming statistical ANTs parity.
- Record paired internal-label Dice/surface metrics, TRE where available, objective values, det-J distribution/folds, export inverse quality, active and edge support, controller/rejection traces, runtime, allocations, and peak RSS.
- ANTs accuracy uses the identical supplied affine with affine estimation disabled. Docker amd64-emulated runtime is reported separately from native ScalaFIM timing.
- Apply predeclared interpretations: A vs B isolates inverse strangulation; A vs C tests midpoint action; A vs D isolates the metric; A vs E compares the complete smaller candidate with the frozen engine.
- Publish a decision receipt selecting, rejecting, or narrowing HalfFlow-CC. A negative result is acceptable only when the failing mechanism is localized and reproducible.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G5: controlled ablation and multi-pair accuracy decision
